title: A workflow may not key its concurrency group on a bare ref — a queued run that never executed can otherwise be cancelled into a permanently dead required check, leaving the PR unmergeable with no code failure

Every path stamping mdata.load_stops.actual_departure_at must write a real clock value (now() or COALESCE onto now()), never a bare client parameter — that stamp is the delivery evidence revenue recognition and invoice gating hang off
